title: best shows on hbo max in 2026
seoTitle: Best Shows on HBO Max in 2026
subtitle: what's trending in streaming in 2026
excerpt: The search for new titles on HBO Max exploded in 2026, driven by the arrival of major franchises and original series premieres.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In 2026, HBO Max consolidated itself as one of the main destinations for those looking for quality content. The combination of established franchises and original premieres generated a peak in interest, making the titles listed here a reference for subscribers.

lanterns, the new superhero series

Lanterns, the first live-action DC Comics series under the direction of James Gunn, premiered in October. The plot follows two Green Lanterns, played by Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre, who investigate a murder in Nebraska. The production, which mixes elements of police drama with the superhero universe, received praise for its more serious approach and for avoiding typical clichés of the genre.

conan o’brien must go, comedy travel show

Conan O’Brien Must Go, in its third season, continues the host's tradition of humorous travel. This season, Conan visits countries such as India, Morocco, the Philippines, and the Netherlands. The series, which follows the model of Anthony Bourdain’s Parts Unknown, offers a lighthearted look at different cultures, maintaining Conan's signature style in every episode.

house of the dragon, the continuation of the iron twins universe

House of the Dragon, third season, maintains the legacy of Game of Thrones. The series features epic battles and political intrigue, highlighting the Battle of the Gullet and the season finale, which reinforces the narrative of George R.R. Martin's universe.

my adventures with superman, adult animation

My Adventures with Superman, in its third season, expands the DC universe in animation format. The series brings new heroes and villains, including Jonathan Kent, known as Superboy. The production continues to be a light and fun entertainment option for adult audiences.

the dark wizard, climbing docuseries

The Dark Wizard, which premiered at SXSW, follows the rise and death of climber Dean Potter. The docuseries, now available on HBO Max, offers an in-depth look into the world of free climbing and the ambitions of an athlete who pushes boundaries.

like water for chocolate, two-season mexican drama

Like Water for Chocolate, second season, brings the Mexican drama produced by Salma Hayek. The plot follows the character Tita, played by Azul Guaita, as she decides between two loves. The series maintains the romantic and cultural tone that made it popular.

hacks, fifth and final season

Hacks reaches its fifth season, wrapping up the series with a greater focus on the relationship between Deborah Vance (Jean Smart) and Ava (Hannah Einbinder). The season features guest stars like Ann Dowd and Katya Zamolodikova, maintaining the humor and depth of the original plot.

a knight of the seven kingdoms, light game of thrones spin-off

A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, based on the novellas by George R.R. Martin, follows Ser Duncan the Tall (Peter Claffey) and his squire Egg (Dexter Sol Ansell). The series offers a more intimate and less epic narrative, focusing on the friendship between the main characters.

neighbors, anthology series about neighbors

Neighbors, a new HBO Max anthology, explores conflicts between neighbors in different regions of the United States. The series brings situations of humor and drama, highlighting privacy issues and community disputes.

rooster, Steve Carell sitcom

Rooster, a sitcom created by Bill Lawrence, stars Steve Carell as a novelist who accepts a teaching position at a liberal arts college. The series combines humor and emotion, following the style of shows like Ted Lasso.

the comeback, return after 12 years

The Comeback returns with its third season, starring Lisa Kudrow as Valerie Cherish. The plot mixes entertainment industry satire with the creation of an AI-written sitcom, exploring the current reality of the media industry.

the pitt, real-time medical drama

The Pitt, second season, continues to follow healthcare professionals at a Pittsburgh trauma center. The series, which covers a 12 to 15-hour shift, presents emergency situations and the characters' personal challenges.

what makes these titles so highly searched

The combination of established franchises like Game of Thrones and DC Comics with new original stories creates a diverse offering that caters to different tastes. In addition, the presence of renowned actors and recognized directors increases the appeal of the series. HBO Max, by making both classic and innovative content available, keeps subscribers engaged and attracts new audiences.

With information from Esquire, TVLine.
